clauses.signature: int read_input(long long *a, long long *b)
clauses.code: int read_input(long long *a, long long *b) { int n; scanf("%d", &n); for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) scanf("%lld%lld", &a[i], &b[i]); return n; }

clauses.signature: long long compute_diff(long long a, long long b)
clauses.code: long long compute_diff(long long a, long long b) { return b - a; }

clauses.signature: void sort_by_diff(long long *a, long long *b, int n)
clauses.code: void sort_by_diff(long long *a, long long *b, int n) { for(int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) { for(int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) { if(compute_diff(a[i], b[i]) < compute_diff(a[j], b[j])) { long long tmp = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = tmp; tmp = b[i]; b[i] = b[j]; b[j] = tmp; } } } }

clauses.signature: long long calc_height(long long *a, long long *b, int n)
clauses.code: long long calc_height(long long *a, long long *b, int n) { long long h = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) { h += a[i]; } return h + b[n-1] - a[n-1]; }

clauses.signature: int main()
clauses.code: int main() { long long a[200000], b[200000]; int n = read_input(a, b); sort_by_diff(a, b, n); printf("%lld\n", calc_height(a, b, n)); return 0; }

clauses.signature: void get_data(int *n, long long *a, long long *b)
clauses.code: void get_data(int *n, long long *a, long long *b) { scanf("%d", n); for(int i = 0; i < *n; i++) scanf("%lld%lld", &a[i], &b[i]); }

clauses.signature: long long diff_value(long long shoulder, long long head)
clauses.code: long long diff_value(long long shoulder, long long head) { return head - shoulder; }

clauses.signature: void bubble_sort(long long *a, long long *b, int n)
clauses.code: void bubble_sort(long long *a, long long *b, int n) { for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) { for(int j = 0; j < n - 1; j++) { if(diff_value(a[j], b[j]) < diff_value(a[j+1], b[j+1])) { long long t = a[j]; a[j] = a[j+1]; a[j+1] = t; t = b[j]; b[j] = b[j+1]; b[j+1] = t; } } } }

clauses.signature: long long compute_max(long long *a, long long *b, int n)
clauses.code: long long compute_max(long long *a, long long *b, int n) { long long sum = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) sum += a[i]; return sum + b[n-1] - a[n-1]; }

clauses.signature: int main()
clauses.code: int main() { int n; long long a[200000], b[200000]; get_data(&n, a, b); bubble_sort(a, b, n); printf("%lld\n", compute_max(a, b, n)); return 0; }

clauses.signature: long long head_shoulder_diff(long long s, long long h)
clauses.code: long long head_shoulder_diff(long long s, long long h) { return h - s; }

clauses.signature: void arrange(long long arr1[], long long arr2[], int cnt)
clauses.code: void arrange(long long arr1[], long long arr2[], int cnt) { int swapped = 1; while(swapped) { swapped = 0; for(int i = 0; i < cnt - 1; i++) { if(head_shoulder_diff(arr1[i], arr2[i]) < head_shoulder_diff(arr1[i+1], arr2[i+1])) { long long tmp = arr1[i]; arr1[i] = arr1[i+1]; arr1[i+1] = tmp; tmp = arr2[i]; arr2[i] = arr2[i+1]; arr2[i+1] = tmp; swapped = 1; } } } }

clauses.signature: long long max_height(long long arr1[], long long arr2[], int cnt)
clauses.code: long long max_height(long long arr1[], long long arr2[], int cnt) { long long res = 0; for(int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) res += arr1[i]; return res - arr1[cnt-1] + arr2[cnt-1]; }

clauses.signature: int main()
clauses.code: int main() { long long arr1[200000], arr2[200000]; int cnt = input(arr1, arr2); arrange(arr1, arr2, cnt); printf("%lld\n", max_height(arr1, arr2, cnt)); return 0; }
